business_summary: Sichuan Jiuyuan Yinhai Software.Co.,Ltd provides medical insurance, digital government affairs, and smart cities services for government departments and industry ecosystem entities in China. The company offers information technology, cloud, and digital activation services in the areas of medical health and insurance, security, human resources, social security, housing finance, and civil affairs, as well as trade unions, smart cities, market supervision, National People's Congress, Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, etc. Sichuan Jiuyuan Yinhai Software.Co.,Ltd was founded in 2008 and is based in Chengdu, China.
